evidence.proposition: USGS defines high-purity quartz by impurity limits, links HPQ to fused quartz crucibles used in silicon-ingot manufacturing for semiconductor wafers, and states that two companies produced U.S. HPQ around Spruce Pine in 2024.

The Quartz Corp states quartz is the second most abundant mineral in Earth's crust, while Spruce Pine ore is unusually suited for high-purity processing and undergoes multiple purification and quality-control steps.
Sibelco temporarily halted Spruce Pine high-purity quartz operations following Hurricane Helene.
The Quartz Corp stopped Spruce Pine operations on September 26, 2024 because of Hurricane Helene and initially had no visibility on restart timing.
Micron announced HBM3E volume production on February 26, 2024.
GlobeNewswire distributed Micron's February 26, 2024 HBM3E volume-production announcement and attributes the release to Micron Technology, Inc.
SK hynix identifies yield optimization, quality and packaging as critical to HBM mass-production capability and states 12-layer HBM3E has higher process complexity than 8-layer HBM3E.
evidence.semantic_limit: DOES_NOT BY ITSELF PROVE EFFECTIVE OUTPUT WAS BINDINGLY LIMITED BY YIELD
